title: Statistical question
objective: Understand Statistical question through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: A question answered by collecting and analysing data with variation.

title: Statistical statement
objective: Understand Statistical statement through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: A numerical claim/summary involving values, proportions, probabilities or predictions.

title: Arithmetic mean
objective: Understand Arithmetic mean through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Sum of values divided by number of values.

title: Median
objective: Understand Median through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Middle value after sorting; average the two middle values for even-sized data.

title: Outlier
objective: Understand Outlier through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: A value that significantly deviates from the rest.

title: Data visualisation
objective: Understand Data visualisation through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Dot plots and graphs help display variation and occurrences.
